title: Chipotle Shrimp Tacos
description: This chipotle shrimp tacos recipe features warm corn tortillas filled with spicy chipotle shrimp, bacon, and onions. Garnish with cilantro and lime juice.
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) package bacon, cut into small pieces
2 pounds large cooked shrimp - peeled, deveined, and cut in half
3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced

steps.text: Cook bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat until evenly browned; drain fat. Stir onion into bacon in the skillet; cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in shrimp and chipotles; cook until heated through, about 4 minutes.

Heat one side 1 tortilla on an ungreased skillet over medium-high heat for 10 to 15 seconds. Flip; heat second side 5 to 10 seconds more. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Fill tortillas with shrimp mixture; sprinkle with cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
